round1: Stephanie opened with 22 points while Marc propped up the table with 9. Marc, Chrissy and Stephanie all picked Ottawa again, making it four years running that Ottawa was a bad idea, and Toronto won it in six.
round2: Jaclyn and Marc tied for the round at 20, with Jaclyn picking all four series in five games for the fourth Round 2 title in a row. Chrissy took Pittsburgh and Toronto, both wrong, and ended the round with 4 points.
round3: Everyone picked New Jersey over Philadelphia, which is the sort of agreement this pool should get used to. Derrick, Marc and Stephanie shared the round at 6 points, while Jaclyn and Chrissy picked Colorado and shared the misery at 3.
round4: Derrick was the only one to take New Jersey in six games, and he got 15 points for it and the lead. Chrissy and Jaclyn picked Dallas in five and have now been wrong about the Cup winner three years in a row. Stephanie is at four.
overall: Derrick won a second straight pool with 53 points, finishing ahead of Stephanie (45) and Jaclyn (40) after a Round 4 where he was the only person to nail New Jersey in six. Chrissy finished last at 17 points, which is also the third consecutive year she has been in the bottom three. Stephanie has now picked the wrong Cup winner four years in a row, a streak you have to work at.
